_comment: Label taxonomy as code (opt-in, see .github/workflows/labels.yml). Source of truth: this file. scripts/ci/labels.py sync creates labels, updates color/description and renames labels listed under 'aliases' (their assignment to issues/PRs is kept). No label is ever deleted. 'paths', 'title_prefixes' and 'title_scopes' drive PR labelling; 'issue_tags' and 'title_words' drive issue labelling. 'inherit_prefixes' names the label families a PR copies from the issues it closes. Add your own area/ and topic/ labels plus the matching 'paths' and 'title_scopes' entries; 'require_path_coverage' makes the test suite fail while a tracked file matches no 'paths' pattern - switch it to true once your rules cover the repo.

labels.name: type/bug
labels.description: Something is broken or behaves wrong

labels.name: type/feature
labels.description: New feature or extension of an existing one

labels.name: type/security
labels.description: Vulnerability, data leak or hardening

labels.name: type/a11y
labels.description: Accessibility: screen readers, keyboard, focus, contrast, touch targets

labels.name: type/ux
labels.description: Layout, visual polish or usability without a functional defect

labels.name: type/docs
labels.description: Documentation only (README, CHANGELOG, docs/)

labels.name: type/chore
labels.description: Maintenance, refactoring, updates without behaviour change

labels.name: type/test
labels.description: Tests only: new, fixed or restructured

labels.name: type/ci
labels.description: Pipeline, workflows, check scripts

labels.name: prio/critical
labels.description: Now: outage, data loss or active leak

labels.name: prio/high
labels.description: Tackle soon

labels.name: prio/medium
labels.description: Normal priority

labels.name: prio/low
labels.description: Some day, when there is time

labels.name: status/triage
labels.description: New, not yet classified

labels.name: status/needs-info
labels.description: Waiting for an answer, a repro or a measurement

labels.name: status/blocked
labels.description: Blocked by another issue or an external factor

labels.name: status/in-progress
labels.description: Being worked on

labels.name: status/duplicate
labels.description: Duplicate, see linked issue

labels.name: status/wontfix
labels.description: Deliberately not done

labels.name: area/ci
labels.description: GitHub Actions, scripts/ci/, rulesets

labels.name: area/docs
labels.description: README, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING, docs/

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

labels.name: Trash Issue
labels.description: Raw idea/note, needs to be worked out before implementation
